remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA GPU was available; the pinned SageAttention extension was not built or imported and its INT8 Q/K kernel was not executed.
No independent numerical comparison used quantized SageAttention output; PyTorch SDPA only validates SGLang tensor layout, scaling, causal behavior, and GQA expansion.
No model serving, perplexity or task-quality, long-context, throughput, latency, or memory measurement was performed.
Dense paged-KV gathering and materialized GQA/MQA expansion remain unbenchmarked and may offset kernel gains, particularly during decode.
Support on the dispatcher's other listed CUDA architectures remains unverified in this environment.
